# Fin-R1: A Large Language Model for Financial Reasoning through Reinforcement Learning

|---|---|---|
| **task** | Building a compact 7B reasoning LLM for financial scenarios that addresses fragmented data, opaque reasoning, and weak transferability in financial tasks. | “In response, we introduce Fin-R1, a reasoning LLM designed for financial scenarios. With a compact size of 7 billion parameters, Fin-R1 reduces deployment costs while addressing the aforementioned challenges.” |
| **architecture** | Two-stage pipeline: data distillation with DeepSeek-R1 and filtering with Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct as judge to build Fin-R1-Data; then SFT on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct followed by GRPO with format and accuracy rewards (Qwen2.5-Max as accuracy evaluator). | “The model is first trained via SFT on Fin-R1-Data and is then optimized through GRPO with two reward functions, a format reward and an accuracy reward.” |
| **data** | Fin-R1-Data: 60,091 bilingual (Chinese/English) CoT entries in four categories, built from FinanceQT, Finance-500K, FinanceIQ, FinPEE, Ant-Finance, FinCorpus, FinQA, ConvFinQA, TFNS, FinCUGE. No market price data or frequency. | “Fin-R1-Data consists of 60,091 bilingual (Chinese and English) entries, organized into four categories, as shown in Figure 3.” |
| **window** | No dated period; evaluation on random 1,000-question samples per dataset (all if fewer), and a stratified 10% test subset of Finance-Instruct-500k. | “For Finance-Instruct-500k, we evaluate the performance various models on a custom 10% test subset, extracted via stratified sampling from the full dataset. For all other datasets, we randomly sample 1,000 questions for testing” |
| **models** | Base model Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct; DeepSeek-R1-671B for distillation; Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct as data-filtering judge; Qwen2.5-Max as RL accuracy evaluator; GPT-4o compared as judge. | “We adopt Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct as the base model.” |
| **baselines** | Eight LLMs: DeepSeek-R1, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B/14B/32B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B, Qwen-2.5-7B/14B/32B-Instruct; plus ablations Fin-R1-SFT and Fin-R1-Zero. | “We compare our Fin-R1 against eight state-of-the-art LLMs, including (i) DeepSeek-R1; (ii) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B; (iii) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B; (iv) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B; (v) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B; (vi) Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct; (vii) Qwen-2.5-14B-Instruct; and (viii) Qwen-2.5-32B-Instruct.” |
